[comment 3]: <> (The following script is meant to display the tsv files in a readable way)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

read_tsv_with_dummy <- function(file_path, row_nb){
    if( ! file.exists(file_path)){
        stop(paste0("\n\n================\n\nINTERNAL ERROR IN Print_report PROCESS.\nfile_path DOES NOT EXISTS: ", file_path, "\n\nPLEASE, REPORT AN ISSUE HERE https://gitlab.pasteur.fr/gmillot/repertoire_profiler/-/issues OR AT gael.millot<AT>pasteur.fr.\n\n========\n\n"), call. = FALSE)
    }else if(file.info(file_path)$size == 0){
        stop(paste0("\n\n================\n\nINTERNAL ERROR IN Print_report PROCESS.\nfile_path FILE IS EMPTY BUT SHOULD NOT BE READ HERE. PATH IS: ", file_path, "\n\nPLEASE, REPORT AN ISSUE HERE https://gitlab.pasteur.fr/gmillot/repertoire_profiler/-/issues OR AT gael.millot<AT>pasteur.fr.\n\n========\n\n"), call. = FALSE)
    }else{
        df <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", fill = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        truncated <- FALSE
        # If the file is empty but has column names, add an empty line to make the column names readable
        if (nrow(df) == 0){
            dummy_row <- as.data.frame(matrix("", nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(df)))
            colnames(dummy_row) <- colnames(df)
            df <- df[ -(1:nrow(df)), ]
        }else if(nrow(df) > row_nb){
            df <- df[1:row_nb, ]
            truncated <- TRUE
        }
        return(list(df = df, truncated = truncated, nb = row_nb))
    }
}
```

escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

  escape(txt),

)
writeLines(out, "nextflow.config.html")

### Most probable strain (by alignment)

Number of reference genomes tested : ```r nb_ref```

The table below indicates the number of variants compared to the indicated genome of reference.<br>
The top one is the most probable background of the tested strain:

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

<span style="color:green">variant_counts.tsv file in the [tsv](./tsv) folder</span>

### Database used

```{r, echo=FALSE}
        # helpers for the database summary: the tables are written as raw html (```{=html} blocks) so that pandoc leaves the sequences and links untouched
        db_dir <- "db_summary"
        db_exists <- function(x){file.exists(file.path(db_dir, x)) && file.info(file.path(db_dir, x))$size > 0}
        db_read_tsv <- function(x){
            read.delim(file.path(db_dir, x), header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", comment.char = "", colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE)
        }
        db_read_fasta <- function(x){
            lines <- readLines(file.path(db_dir, x), warn = FALSE)
            head_idx <- grep("^>", lines)
            ids <- sub("^>(\\S+).*$", "\\1", lines[head_idx])
            ends <- c(head_idx[-1] - 1, length(lines))
            seqs <- mapply(function(s, e){if(e > s){paste(lines[(s + 1):e], collapse = "")}else{""}}, head_idx, ends)
            setNames(gsub("\\s", "", seqs), ids)
        }
        db_escape <- function(x){
            x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
            x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
            x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
            gsub("\"", "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
        }
        db_link <- function(url, text){paste0('<a href="', db_escape(url), '" target="_blank">', db_escape(text), '</a>')}
        # one sequence, 60 bases per line, in a collapsible block
        db_seq_view <- function(seq, label){
            if(is.na(seq) || seq == ""){return("<i>not in the fasta file</i>")}
            starts <- seq(1, nchar(seq), by = 60)
            wrapped <- paste(substring(seq, starts, pmin(starts + 59, nchar(seq))), collapse = "\n")
            paste0('<details><summary style="color: #1a73e8; cursor: pointer;">', db_escape(label), '</summary><pre style="white-space: pre; font-size: 0.8em; max-height: 300px; overflow: auto;">', wrapped, '</pre></details>')
        }
        # df cells are html already, column names are not
        db_html_table <- function(df){
            df[] <- lapply(df, as.character) # otherwise apply() pads the numbers with spaces
            head <- paste0("<tr>", paste0("<th>", db_escape(names(df)), "</th>", collapse = ""), "</tr>")
            rows <- apply(df, 1, function(r){paste0("<tr>", paste0("<td>", r, "</td>", collapse = ""), "</tr>")})
            paste0('<table class="table table-condensed table-striped" style="font-size: 0.9em;"><thead>', head, '</thead><tbody>', paste(rows, collapse = ""), '</tbody></table>')
        }
        db_view <- function(file_txt, table_html){
            cat(paste0('\n\n```{=html}\n&nbsp; <details class="inline"><summary style="color: #1a73e8; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1em; font-weight: bold;">view</summary>\n<span style="color:green">', file_txt, ':</span><br><br>\n', table_html, '\n<br>\n</details>\n```\n\n'))
        }
        db_none <- function(what){cat(paste0('<span style="color:grey;font-style:italic;">', what, ' not available in this run (strain identity off, or database not built).</span>\n\n'))}
        organism <- NULL
        if(db_exists("organism.tsv")){
            organism <- db_read_tsv("organism.tsv")
            organism <- setNames(organism$value, organism$key)
        }
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
        if( ! is.null(organism)){
            cat(paste0("Organism: <i>", db_escape(organism["organism_name"]), "</i>. Reference genome: ", db_escape(organism["reference_name"]), ".<br><br>\n\n"))
        }else{
            db_none("Database description (organism.tsv)")
        }
```

#### Strains

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
        if(db_exists("panel_sites.tsv.gz") && db_exists("panel_strains.tsv")){
            # the site table is stored by exception: a strain not listed at a site carries the reference allele there
            sites <- read.delim(gzfile(file.path(db_dir, "panel_sites.tsv.gz")), header = TRUE, sep = "	", quote = "", comment.char = "", colClasses = "character")
            strains <- db_read_tsv("panel_strains.tsv")
            n_strains <- nrow(strains)
            strain_counts <- function(column){ # number of sites listing each strain (0-based index) in column
                idx <- as.integer(unlist(strsplit(column[column != ""], ",", fixed = TRUE)))
                tabulate(idx + 1, nbins = n_strains)
            }
            carriers <- as.integer(sites$n_alt) + as.integer(sites$n_het)
            # specific: the strain is the only one of the panel to carry the alternative allele
            private <- carriers == 1
            owner <- ifelse(sites$alt_strains[private] != "", sites$alt_strains[private], sites$het_strains[private])
            n_indel <- sum(nchar(sites$ref) != nchar(sites$alt))
            df <- data.frame(
                "Strain" = db_escape(strains$display_name),
                "Clade" = db_escape(strains$clade),
                "Origin" = db_escape(strains$origin),
                "Source" = db_escape(strains$source_type),
                "Specific SNPs/indels" = tabulate(as.integer(owner) + 1, nbins = n_strains),
                "Sites with the alternative allele" = strain_counts(sites$alt_strains) + strain_counts(sites$het_strains),
                "Sites not called" = strain_counts(sites$unknown_strains),
                check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
            source_counts <- table(strains$source_type)
            cat(paste0("Number of yeast strains available for identification: <b>", n_strains, "</b> (", db_escape(paste(paste(source_counts, names(source_counts)), collapse = ", ")), "), over <b>", nrow(sites), "</b> informative sites (", nrow(sites) - n_indel, " SNPs, ", n_indel, " indels).<br>
"))
            cat("A specific site is one where the strain is the only one of the panel to carry the alternative allele. Strains of one clonal family (the S288C family for instance) are separated by these sites only.<br>
")
            db_view("panel_sites.tsv.gz and panel_strains.tsv files of the database", paste0('<div style="max-height: 600px; overflow: auto;">', db_html_table(df), '</div>'))
        }else{
            db_none("Strain panel (panel_sites.tsv.gz, panel_strains.tsv)")
        }
```

#### Native markers

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
        if(db_exists("marker_loci.tsv")){
            loci <- db_read_tsv("marker_loci.tsv")
            seqs <- if(db_exists("marker_loci.fasta")){db_read_fasta("marker_loci.fasta")}else{character(0)}
            # flanks in lower case, ORF in upper case (orf_start and orf_end are 0-based, end excluded, in the gene orientation)
            locus_seq <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(loci)), function(i){
                s <- seqs[loci$locus_id[i]]
                if(is.na(s)){return(NA)}
                a <- as.integer(loci$orf_start[i])
                b <- as.integer(loci$orf_end[i])
                paste0(tolower(substr(s, 1, a)), toupper(substr(s, a + 1, b)), tolower(substr(s, b + 1, nchar(s))))
            })
            sys_id <- loci$systematic_id
            df <- data.frame(
                "Gene" = ifelse(loci$ensembl_name == loci$gene, db_escape(loci$gene), paste0(db_escape(loci$gene), " (", db_escape(loci$ensembl_name), ")")),
                "Systematic ID" = db_escape(sys_id),
                "Links" = paste(
                    db_link(paste0("https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/", sys_id), "SGD"),
                    db_link(paste0("https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/?term=", sys_id), "NCBI Gene"),
                    db_link(paste0("https://www.ensembl.org/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae/Gene/Summary?g=", sys_id), "Ensembl"),
                    sep = " | "
                ),
                "Location" = db_escape(paste0(sub("^ref\\|(.*)\\|$", "\\1", loci$chrom), ":", loci$genome_start, "-", loci$genome_end, " (", loci$strand, ")")),
                "ORF (bp)" = loci$orf_length,
                "Protein (aa)" = loci$protein_length,
                "Loss of function phenotype" = db_escape(loci$loss_of_function_phenotype),
                "Sequence" = sapply(seq_len(nrow(loci)), function(i){db_seq_view(locus_seq[i], paste0("view (", nchar(locus_seq[i]), " bp)"))}),
                check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
            cat(paste0("Number of native markers: <b>", nrow(loci), "</b> (", db_escape(paste(loci$gene, collapse = ", ")), ").<br>\n"))
            cat("Sequences are the locus in the gene orientation: ORF in upper case, 1 kb flanks in lower case.<br>\n")
            db_view("marker_loci.tsv and marker_loci.fasta files of the database", db_html_table(df))
        }else{
            db_none("Native marker database (marker_loci.tsv)")
        }
```

#### Biomolecular tools

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
        if(db_exists("tools.tsv")){
            tools <- db_read_tsv("tools.tsv")
            seqs <- if(db_exists("tools.fasta")){db_read_fasta("tools.fasta")}else{character(0)}
            tool_seq <- unname(seqs[tools$element_id])
            df <- data.frame(
                "Element ID" = db_escape(tools$element_id),
                "Name" = db_escape(tools$name),
                "Class" = db_escape(tools$element_class),
                "Origin" = db_escape(tools$origin),
                "Length (bp)" = tools$length_bp,
                "Scorable" = db_escape(tools$scorable),
                "Source plasmid" = ifelse(tools$source_page == "", db_escape(tools$source_plasmid), db_link(tools$source_page, tools$source_plasmid)),
                "Links" = ifelse(is.na(tool_seq), "", db_link(paste0("https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi?PROGRAM=blastn&PAGE_TYPE=BlastSearch&DATABASE=nt&QUERY=", tool_seq), "NCBI BLAST")),
                "Sequence" = sapply(tool_seq, function(s){db_seq_view(s, paste0("view (", nchar(s), " bp)"))}),
                check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
            cat(paste0("Number of biomolecular tool elements: <b>", nrow(tools), "</b> (", sum(tools$origin == "foreign"), " foreign, ", sum(tools$origin == "native"), " native to the host genome; ", sum(tools$scorable == "yes"), " long enough to be scored).<br>\n"))
            cat("Native elements are host sequence: a wild-type strain covers them, so they are not evidence of engineering. Tool elements are synthetic constructs without a gene record: each is linked to its source plasmid page and to a NCBI BLAST search of its sequence.<br>\n")
            db_view("tools.tsv and tools.fasta files of the database", db_html_table(df))
        }else{
            db_none("Biomolecular tool database (tools.tsv)")
        }
```
